_note: human_hints.json only declares type: "vocal" (positive). The other two scored classes — residual (an inferable-but-not-lead vocal construct: filtered/looped/sampled, excluded from precision/recall, firing rate reported as a diagnostic only) and negative (operator's explicit "no vocals", including instrument bleed into the vocal stem) — live only in hint prose, which defeats keyword matching (e.g. ayuni hint-005's summary contains the string "no vocal" but is residual). So classification for every non-vocal hint is declared here per song, not guessed. `unknown` marks a hint that has been reviewed but asserts nothing about vocal presence (e.g. Armin's drop-gesture hints) — same as unreviewed time: excluded entirely, neither credit nor error. A hint id absent from both `type: "vocal"` and this map fails loud in scorer.ground_truth(). Positives are never listed here — they come from type == "vocal" in human_hints.json itself. See docs/issues.md and docs/experiments.md 'Ground truth is three classes, not two'.
